hotspots.description:
Every war begins with a sign.

Before the Rebel Ants were forced to choose sides, before the blades, the betrayals, and the battles that would shake the colony forever, there was a warning carried through the shadows.

At first, it was only a whisper. A feeling. A shift in the air. Something ancient was moving beneath the surface, and the peace the colony had known was beginning to break.

The Warning tells the beginning of the Rebel Ants saga, where loyalty is tested, enemies rise in silence, and the strongest warriors must face a truth none of them are ready for.

The colony is no longer safe.

And what comes next will decide the future of the Rebel Universe.
